title: CANcestry reliability-growth history row (v0.1.0)
description: Row contract for hw/fmeda/mtbf-history.csv (issue #56, H-09 commit 4; HW-NF-004, HW-SF-005). Append-only history written by ci/check_hw_reliability_growth.py: one row per accepted FMEDA state, keyed by the sha256 of hw/fmeda/fmeda-analysis.csv (no wall-clock timestamps; HwAGENTS.md rule 5). mtbf_hours is the reliability MTBF 1e9 / sum(lambda_total FIT) over every part of the FMEDA; pmhf_fit and mean_time_to_sg_violation_hours (1e9 / PMHF) are recorded alongside so the two 'MTBF' notions of issue #56 are never conflated. The checker fails closed on a missing, empty, malformed or non-monotonic history and on an MTBF drop greater than 10 percent against the last accepted row.
